name: Node.js MUD/MUSH engine with JavaScript soft-code

mentions.name: Node.js MUD/MUSH engine with JavaScript soft-code
mentions.description: A MUD (closer to a MUSH) engine written in Node.js where everything is an entity with attributes, and the soft-code language is JavaScript executed via the Node.js vm module. Each soft-code execution runs in a new isolated context, and Proxy objects gate access to entities and attributes (e.g., attributes normally accessible only by their owners). Built-in commands include @eval and @set-attribute, and it has separate clients for Discord, Slack, and a local console; the MUSH outputs markdown so each client can format it however it likes. Basic sandboxing is in place (eval, Function, and Promise disabled) and it is a proof of concept the author plans to make public one day.
mentions.source_excerpt:
This year, I am creating a nodejs MUD, well closer to a MUSH actually.

* Everything is an Entity with Attributes
* A player is an Entity with its client property set
* There's a handful of built-in commands, but the important ones are @eval and @set-attribute
* The soft-code language is ... JavaScript.
* It uses the vm module from nodejs[0] to execute stuff.
* It has separate clients (so far) for Discord, Slack, and local console. It's easy to add more and will be easier after I do this one refactor.
mentions.author: kageneko
